evidence.observation: Konami original two-view isolated model presentation, lower view establishes the termination at the horizontal mounting plane
2008 PS2 in-game footage at 72s; scene placement

finding: The lower original Konami rendering shows the entire suspended fixture to its shared horizontal mounting plane, the bottom edges of the two side panels and the central projection. The official guide and PS2 encounter anchor its identity in Room 500. The former close-ups did not show how to delimit this installation. The plane ends the selection illustration. Environment beyond it is excluded.
scope: Candidate for a single selection illustration of a fixed assembly. No new playable stance, motion or fidelity certification.
